intro.en: Genres, the parts of a story, and the verbs for talking and writing about books.

texto.en:
**Genres.** **La narrativa**: **la novela**, **el relato** or **el cuento**, **la leyenda**. **La poesía**, written in **verso**. **El teatro**. **El ensayo**. Novels can be **históricas**, **de aventuras**, **de ciencia ficción**, **rosa** (romance) or **negra** (crime).

**Inside a story.** **El argumento** is what happens. **El tema** is what it is about. **El narrador** tells it, in first or third person. **Los personajes**: **el protagonista**, **los secundarios**. It is **ambientada en** a place and a time. The end is **el desenlace**.

**Summarising.** Use the present:

- **La novela trata de** un hombre que…
- **Está ambientada en** el Madrid de los años cuarenta.
- **Cuenta la historia de**…
- **El protagonista es** un joven que…
- **Al final**…

**Judging.** **Tiene un estilo ágil**, **cuidado**, **directo**, **elegante**. **Engancha** (it grips you). **Se hace pesada** (it drags). **Es un clásico.**

**The book trade.** **La editorial** **publica** or **edita** the book. **La tirada** is the number of copies. If it sells well, **se agota** and there is **una segunda edición**. **Un superventas** is a best-seller.

**Poetry.** **Un verso** is one line; several make **una estrofa**. Lines **riman**. You **recitas** a poem.

**False friends.** **La librería** is a bookshop, and the library is **la biblioteca**. **El argumento** is a plot (and also an argument in a debate, but never a quarrel). **Una novela** is a novel; **un cuento** is a short story.

frases.es: Cien años de soledad, la novela más famosa de Gabriel García Márquez, estuvo a punto de no publicarse.
frases.en: One Hundred Years of Solitude, Gabriel García Márquez's most famous novel, very nearly did not get published.
analisis: la novela más famosa de Gabriel García Márquez
estuvo a punto de no publicarse

frases.es: El autor tardó dieciocho meses en escribirla, encerrado en su casa de México mientras su mujer vendía lo que tenían para comer.
frases.en: The author took eighteen months to write it, shut up in his house in Mexico while his wife sold what they had in order to eat.
analisis: encerrado en su casa de México

frases.es: Cuando la terminó, no tenían dinero para enviar el manuscrito entero a la editorial, de modo que mandaron solo la mitad.
frases.en: When he finished it, they had no money to send the whole manuscript to the publisher, so they sent only half.

frases.es: La novela narra la historia de siete generaciones de una familia en un pueblo imaginario llamado Macondo.
frases.en: The novel tells the story of seven generations of a family in an imaginary village called Macondo.
analisis: la historia de siete generaciones de una familia

frases.es: En ella lo extraordinario se cuenta con la misma naturalidad que lo cotidiano, un estilo que se conoce como realismo mágico.
frases.en: In it the extraordinary is told as naturally as the everyday, a style known as magical realism.
analisis: con la misma naturalidad que lo cotidiano
que se conoce como realismo mágico

frases.es: La primera tirada, de ocho mil ejemplares, se agotó en pocas semanas.
frases.en: The first print run, of eight thousand copies, sold out in a few weeks.

frases.es: Desde entonces se ha traducido a decenas de lenguas, y su autor recibió el Premio Nobel en 1982.
frases.en: Since then it has been translated into dozens of languages, and its author received the Nobel Prize in 1982.

pregunta.en: According to the text, why did they send only half the manuscript?

They could not afford to post all of it.en: No tenían dinero para enviar el manuscrito entero.

The publisher asked for half.en: The text does not say that.

bloques.correcta: It sold out in a few weeks

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a review of a novel: plot, characters, setting, style and your judgement.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Summarise aloud the plot of a book you love and explain why it matters to you.
